name: But You Seem Fine
source:
Rae Kim is your average 14-year-old dweeb, but at the beginning of her freshman year in high school, she suddenly gets sick and doesn't know why. Follow her journey as she and her mom struggle to find out what's wrong.

[From [url=https://but-you-seem-fine.webflow.io/]official website[/url]]
translation:
Rae Kim是一个普通的14岁宅女，可在高中一年级开学时，她突然病倒，却不知道原因。跟随她与母亲一起寻找病因、努力弄清究竟出了什么问题。

[来源：[url=https://but-you-seem-fine.webflow.io/]官方网站[/url]]
